channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Gujarat Class 12 Student Slaps Woman Teacher for Questioning Late Entry in Pre-Board Exam; FIR Filed
item.description: A classroom assault caught on CCTV has reignited concerns over student aggression, teacher safety, and accountability in schools.

item.title: Bengaluru Road Rage: Two Drunk Women Assault Cab Driver, Bystanders, Resist Police, Viral Video Sparks Outrage
item.description: After a late‑night minor collision in Bengaluru’s Hulimavu, two intoxicated women allegedly assaulted a cab driver, sparked chaos among bystanders and resisted police, in an incident now circulating widely on social media.

item.title: Nataša Stanković says “Not Everything That Looks Good Is Safe”, In Insight Cosmetics’ Latest Campaign
item.description: From a single product in 2012 to 1000+ SKUs today, Insight Cosmetics promotes cruelty-free, dermatologically safe beauty choices.

item.title: Bihar: Protests Erupt After 6-Year-Old Allegedly Raped and Murdered in Darbhanga; Neighbor Arrested, Probe On
item.description: The brutal rape and murder of a minor in Darbhanga has triggered violent public protests, leading to the arrest of a 22-year-old neighbor and a government pledge for a 60-day fast-track conviction.

item.title: Karnataka: 22-Year-Old Woman Dies by Suicide, Family Alleges In-Laws Forced Her Into Prostitution
item.description: A 22-year-old mother from Karnataka died by suicide after allegedly enduring harassment and pressure from her in-laws to engage in prostitution, prompting police to arrest three family members.

item.title: From Record Holder at 7 to National Champion at 9: The Extraordinary Journey of Racing Prodigy Arshi Gupta
item.description: Nine-year-old Arshi Gupta has become India’s youngest racing licence holder and national karting champion, earning global recognition.

item.title: Kerala Influencer Chinnu Pappu, 24, Found Dead in Kasaragod; Police Probe Suspected Suicide
item.description: The 24-year-old social media creator was found dead in her Kasaragod home, with police investigating the circumstances and urging against speculation.

item.title: Hyderabad Employee Fired After Questioning 16-Hour Workdays, Moves Labour Department For Justice
item.description: A Hyderabad IT professional has accused his former employer of forcing extreme 16-hour workdays without overtime pay and firing him for demanding fair compensation.

item.title: From Flames to Fame: Chennai Photographer Ramya Sriram’s Risk-Filled Theyyam Image Wins Global Nat Geo Honour
item.description: Chennai photographer Ramya Sriram’s dramatic image of Kerala’s Kandanar Kelan Theyyam ritual has won the Nat Geo India Worldwide Contest 2025 and will feature in the 2026 calendar.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: Dalmandi Demolition Triggers Protests as Historic Varanasi Market Cleared for Kashi Vishwanath Access Road
item.description: A large-scale demolition in Varanasi’s Dalmandi market to widen access to the Kashi Vishwanath temple has triggered protests, police deployment and concerns over livelihoods and heritage.
